tools.name: find_tools
tools.description: Search AgentGid for agents, coding tools, APIs, models and stacks that fit a goal, e.g. 'Solana LP copy-trading bot', 'web search API for a research agent under $50/month', 'generate 3D models for a game'. Returns candidates grouped by kind with prices, free tiers and links. Use this first, then get

tools.name: list_api_categories
tools.description: List the categories of APIs for agents AgentGid compares (web search, scraping, sandboxes, memory, vector DBs, LLM gateways, email, voice, payments, blockchain RPC, DEX swap, crypto data, 3D, image, audio, video generation).

tools.name: find_apis
tools.description: Compare APIs in one category on official price, free tier, MCP support, SDK downloads and status. Filters are optional.

tools.name: get_api
tools.description: Full details of one API: pricing (free tier, plans, usage price, notes), SDK packages, MCP server, status, cheaper alternatives.

tools.name: get_agent
tools.description: Details of an AI agent or developer tool (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot, Headroom ...): pricing, plan usage limits, live status and incidents, latest release, popularity, safety settings.

tools.name: check_status
tools.description: Live status of agents and APIs from their official status pages, with incidents in the last 30 days.

tools.name: model_prices
tools.description: API prices of LLMs (per 1M input/output tokens, context) and which agents can use them. Optional filter by name.

tools.name: real_world_usage
tools.description: From public GitHub repos set up for AI coding agents: the MCP servers developers connect (overall or per agent), common combinations, and per domain (Solana bots, EVM apps, games, agent products, mobile) the APIs, SDKs and packages they use.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_api_categories · Private data: model_prices · Public sink: list_api_categories.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_api_categories · Private data: model_prices · Public sink: list_api_categories

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
